title: Literal parsing representation
statement: Let $x$ and $r$ be finite bit strings, and let $\ell=(v,b)$ be a literal with variable index $v\in\mathbb N$ and polarity bit $b\in\{0,1\}$. If parsing $x$ returns $\ell$ and remainder $r$, then $x=1^{v+1}0b\,r$.
hypotheses_covered: Parsing $x$ returns the literal $\ell$ with remainder $r$
